note: KR stocks fed to freqtrade under borrowed Binance spot USDT pair names (the engine only accepts listed markets). Each borrowed market has amount step 1 (integer shares), price precision <= 1e-4 and price max 1000. Prices are divided by price_scale = 10000 (1 unit = 10,000 won, 0.0001 = 1 won); volume is unchanged (shares). Stake currency USDT = units of 10,000 won. Universe = the 10 largest traded values in the stored Toss 1m files 2026-01-12..2026-11-05, chosen before any backtest. time_axis=compressed: real bars are re-stamped onto a gap-free clock (bar i at 2020-01-01 UTC + i x timeframe) so the engine does not fill closed-market hours with synthetic flat candles; the real time of every bar is kept in <pair>-<tf>.timemap.csv. Source files are copied once to user_data/data_kr_c/source_snapshot/ before conversion (the live files keep growing while the backfill runs) and cut to the KST window 2026-01-12..2026-11-05.
